description: Land Title Settlement Department - Dewarammulla, Pallepola D/S/Devision Matale District - Cad. Map No. 310008 (24/0268)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a formal declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title to specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, block numbers, and location details), along with a schedule listing ownership details, extents, and classifications of the land parcels. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it concerns land registration, title determination, and property ownership matters.
